source: Jira REST via the Atlassian connector, expand=changelog, EP project

computedWith.script: flow/compute_flow.py over flow/raw/*.json (one compacted changelog per issue, written by flow/extract.py)

sample.design: 50 EP stories and bugs that reached Done between 2 Sep 2026 and 22 Sep 2026 (35 stories, 15 bugs), plus the 15 pipeline tickets in scope so the queue picture carries work in flight. Picked as the most recently finished work, so it over-represents the fortnight around the 15 Sep workflow migration.
sample.fullScope: about 1,200 EP stories and bugs created in 2026; the full pull is a scheduled batch, not a chat session

rules.businessDays: weekends stripped in UTC; public holidays kept

migration.what: bulk move to the new EP workflow: COMPLETE became DONE, RC approved, Staged for Release, QA Tested and Direct Deploy moved to Ready for release, Ready for deploy renamed QA Tested

queue.note: sample only: 64 issues, so depths are indicative, not a census
